name: Foreman Thazz'ril
summary: In the Valley of Trials, Foreman Thazz'ril keeps the peons at work. Crews gather what the encampment and young warriors need, but sleepers and nearby cultists test his patience.

sections.title: Keeping the Peons in Line
sections.body: In the Valley of Trials, Foreman Thazz'ril directs peons as they chop lumber and gather materials for the encampment and young warriors. Durotar's harsh red rock demands steady labor, but the peons often nap beneath the desert sun. So Thazz'ril sends newly arrived recruits to rouse them with his blackjack and keep construction moving.

sections.title: A Lost Pick in Dangerous Hands
sections.body: Thazz'ril was scouting the Burning Blade Coven for mineral resources when dark cultists drove him to flee. In his haste, he left behind his treasured enchanted pick. Warlocks and their demonic minions now gather in the cave. Too cautious to retrieve it himself, Thazz'ril depends on young Horde aspirants to venture into the depths and bring it back.

faq.answer: Foreman Thazz'ril is an orc labor supervisor in the Valley of Trials in Durotar. He manages work crews, oversees lumber chopping, and scouts the region for resources to aid the Horde's settlement.

faq.q: Why does Thazz'ril give players a blackjack?
faq.answer: The peons under Thazz'ril's watch often sleep instead of gathering lumber. He gives recruits an enchanted wooden blackjack to rouse them and send them back to work.

faq.q: Why is Thazz'ril's pick inside the Burning Blade cave?
faq.answer: Thazz'ril left his enchanted pick in the Burning Blade Coven while scouting for mineral veins. He fled when he encountered the cultists inside.

faq.q: What is his role in the Horde?
faq.answer: Thazz'ril is a civilian overseer, not a frontline soldier or shaman. He supervises manual labor, keeps construction supplies ready, and keeps the peons productive.

angles.text: As a young orc coming of age, you see how Horde strength on the battlefield depends on disciplined labor.
As a miner, you can see how much Thazz'ril values his equipment. He is desperate to recover his enchanted pick from the Burning Blade Coven.
